description: Starter Fiverr scam-detection message dataset for development, testing, and rule prototyping. Synthetic examples only; not a trained production dataset.

examples.text: Can you deliver the logo by Friday? Please send the first draft here on Fiverr.
examples.reason: Normal project discussion with no suspicious request.

examples.text: Please send me your WhatsApp number so we can continue this project there.
examples.reason: Attempts to move communication away from Fiverr.

examples.text: Message my manager on Telegram @projectmanager before I place the order.
examples.reason: Moves communication to Telegram and adds pressure before ordering.

examples.text: I already paid. Fiverr needs your email address before the payment can be released.
examples.reason: Claims a platform payment process that should be verified inside Fiverr.

examples.text: Enter your debit card information on this verification page so your Fiverr payment can be released.
examples.reason: Requests financial information through an external verification flow.

examples.text: Send me the six digit code Fiverr just texted you so I can complete the order.
examples.reason: Requests a one-time verification code.

examples.text: Do not send anyone your password or OTP. Fiverr support will never ask you for it in chat.
examples.reason: Warning against credential sharing rather than requesting credentials.

examples.text: Please send your Fiverr username and password so I can verify your seller profile.
examples.reason: Direct credential theft request.

examples.text: I can pay you more if you accept USDT outside Fiverr.
examples.reason: Attempts to move payment off platform and use cryptocurrency.

examples.text: Buy a $100 gift card and send me the code. I will reimburse you with the project payment.
examples.reason: Gift card payment and reimbursement scam pattern.

examples.text: You need to pay a $35 seller verification fee before Fiverr can release the order.
examples.reason: Requests an advance fee while impersonating a platform process.

examples.text: Download this ZIP file and run the app so you can see the project requirements.
examples.reason: Encourages running an unknown downloaded application.

examples.text: Install AnyDesk and send me the access code. I will show you the task on my computer.
examples.reason: Requests remote-access software credentials.

examples.text: Your account will be suspended in 10 minutes unless you verify it using this link.
examples.reason: Threat-based urgency combined with an external verification link.

examples.text: Can you send the final files through Fiverr delivery when they are ready?
examples.reason: Normal platform-safe workflow.

examples.text: What is your email? I need it for the brand guidelines document.
examples.reason: Could be legitimate depending on context; no payment or credential request.

examples.text: Send me your email and card number so I can add you to our company payroll system.
examples.reason: Requests sensitive financial information.

examples.text: I cannot pay through Fiverr. Send me your PayPal address and I will pay directly.
examples.reason: Explicit request to bypass Fiverr payment.

examples.text: I attached a PDF with the project brief. Please review it and tell me your quote.
examples.reason: Normal project attachment behavior.

examples.text: Click the payment confirmation link and log in again because your seller session expired.
examples.reason: External login request tied to payment confirmation.

examples.text: I need your bank account number and routing number before I can place the Fiverr order.
examples.reason: Requests unnecessary banking information.

examples.text: Can we have a Zoom call to discuss the scope? I will place the order on Fiverr first.
examples.reason: External meeting request but payment remains on platform and context appears legitimate.

examples.text: Fiverr support here. We detected a problem with your account. Reply with your password to unlock it.
examples.reason: Platform impersonation combined with password theft.

examples.text: Pay the customs fee first and I will release your $2,000 project payment afterward.
examples.reason: Advance-fee scam pattern.

examples.text: Can you create three thumbnails for my YouTube channel? My budget is $120.
examples.reason: Normal project inquiry.

examples.text: Scan this QR code to confirm your seller account and receive the payment.
examples.reason: QR-based verification request tied to payment.

examples.text: I sent the requirements in the Fiverr order page. Let me know if anything is unclear.
examples.reason: Normal on-platform communication.

examples.text: Use this shortened link to confirm your identity before we begin.
examples.reason: Identity verification through an unexplained external shortened link.

examples.text: Before I order, send $20 to prove you are a real freelancer. I will send it back.
examples.reason: Requests money from the seller before placing an order.

examples.text: Please keep all communication and payments on Fiverr for both of our protection.
examples.reason: Encourages safe platform behavior.
